summary.text: JoAnn Tolentino is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 45-Position 1, facing Democratic incumbent Roger Goodman in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website describes her as a teacher, music instructor and compliance professional.

paragraphs.text: JoAnn Tolentino's campaign website describes her as a teacher, wife, mother and grandmother who has been married for 46 years, raised four children and adopted a child from foster care.
She says she taught private music lessons for 34 years, studied music therapy, and has worked in governance, risk and compliance.
Tolentino's platform emphasizes election integrity, including voter ID, paper ballots and bipartisan oversight, and free speech and parental rights in education and healthcare.
